title: YAP/TAZ drives Notch and angiogenesis mechanoregulation in silico.
authors: Passier, Margot; Bentley, Katie; Loerakker, Sandra; Ristori, Tommaso
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算模型模拟YAP/TAZ与Notch信号通路对血管生成的力学调控，虽涉及信号通路建模，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且方法为通路级模拟而非AI/物理分子模拟。
abstract: Endothelial cells are key players in the cardiovascular system. Among other things, they are responsible for sprouting angiogenesis, the process of new blood vessel formation essential for both health and disease. Endothelial cells are strongly regulated by the juxtacrine signaling pathway Notch. Recent studies have shown that both Notch and angiogenesis are influenced by extracellular matrix stiffness; however, the underlying mechanisms are poorly understood. Here, we addressed this challenge by combining computational models of Notch signaling and YAP/TAZ, stiffness- and cytoskeleton-regulated mechanotransducers whose activity inhibits both Dll4 (Notch ligand) and LFng (Notch-Dll4 binding modulator). Our simulations successfully mimicked previous experiments, indicating that this YAP/TAZ-Notch crosstalk elucidates the Notch and angiogenesis mechanoresponse to stiffness. Additional simulations also identified possible strategies to control Notch activity and sprouting angiogenesis via cytoskeletal manipulations or spatial patterns of alternating stiffnesses. Our study thus inspires new experimental avenues and provides a promising modeling framework for further investigations into the role of Notch, YAP/TAZ, and mechanics in determining endothelial cell behavior during angiogenesis and similar processes.
abstract_zh: 内皮细胞是心血管系统中的关键角色。除其他功能外，它们负责发芽性血管生成（sprouting angiogenesis），即新血管形成的过程，这对健康和疾病均至关重要。内皮细胞受到邻分泌信号通路Notch的强烈调控。近期研究表明，Notch和血管生成均受细胞外基质刚度影响；然而，其潜在机制尚不明确。在此，我们通过结合Notch信号传导与YAP/TAZ的计算模型来应对这一挑战，YAP/TAZ是受刚度及细胞骨架调控的机械转导因子，其活性抑制Dll4（Notch配体）和LFng（Notch-Dll4结合调节因子）。我们的模拟成功复现了先前实验，表明这种YAP/TAZ-Notch串扰阐明了Notch和血管生成对刚度的机械响应。额外模拟还识别了通过细胞骨架操作或交替刚度空间模式来控制Notch活性和发芽性血管生成的潜在策略。因此，我们的研究启发了新的实验途径，并为进一步探究Notch、YAP/TAZ及力学在血管生成及类似过程中决定内皮细胞行为的作用，提供了一个有前景的建模框架。
